model: radius-one root-contact types canonicalized under the root tile's proper rotational stabilizer

algorithm.kind: exact minimum hitting set with GCTS counterexample oracle
algorithm.excluded_trivial_clauses: every candidate containing a complete single-target-cell coverage clause
algorithm.minimality: the 92 accumulated legal coronas have no admissible hitting set of size below six; a six-type set then exhausts the exact corona search

forced_disjunction.interpretation: Every legal first corona contains at least one placement from these six symmetry-canonical contact types. No smaller such disjunction survives after excluding single-cell coverage clauses.

warning: This is a nontrivial local compatibility rule, not a space-tiling certificate, substitution hierarchy, or aperiodicity proof.
